period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)' (p.7) and its Off-Balance-Sheet/NAV continuation (p.8) and 'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (p.9) — distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements for BRAC Bank Limited and its subsidiaries printed earlier in the same filing (p.2-6). Matches the basis of this bank's own 2021-2025 Q4/annual series (solo). Figures read visually from 150dpi page renders (image-based PDF, no text layer; only the first 22 of the filing's approx. 34 pages were rendered). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Jun 2022' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended Apr to Jun 2022' column (interest income 6,720,601,400; PAT 1,198,121,332; EPS 0.80) not recorded here, kept for a future finer-grained pass. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: asset components (cash+balances+money at call+investments+loans+fixed assets+other assets+non-banking assets) sum to 499,082,125,310 = reported Total property and assets; liabilities+equity (444,064,072,772 + 55,018,052,538) = 499,082,125,310, an exact match. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII+Investment income+Commission+Other operating income=Total operating income; less opex=profit before provisions; less provision=PBT; less tax=PAT). Comparative (31 Dec 2021) Total shareholders' equity (54,419,471,131) and Total assets (449,084,124,881) both match this bank's own 2021_Q4.json exactly — no restatement observed. No CAR/NPL/ROA/ROE 'Performance Highlights' ratio table was found within the rendered page range (pages 1-22 of an approx. 34-page document, which only reached partway into the notes to accounts); if such a table exists in this filing it falls beyond page 22. 'Profit/(loss) before provisions' is the only such subtotal line in the solo P&L (no separate 'Operating profit' line above it, unlike the consolidated P&L on p.4 which has both, separated by 'Share of profit/(loss) of associates'), so per this bank's established convention for solo statements lacking a distinct operating-profit line (see 2016_Q2.json, 2023_Q2.json) it is recorded here as operating_profit_cumulative. The equity sub-reserves 'Dividend equalization fund', 'Revaluation reserve on govt. securities', 'Fair value gain/(loss) on equity investment' and 'Translation reserve' were visible on the balance sheet but, per this bank's established convention, are not recorded as separate line items (only the four standard components + total are captured).

source.retrieval_method: The live bracbank.com site is reachable today but has been restructured (confirmed: the old /financialstatement/ path now redirects to /en/financialstatement/, where this specific file 404s); the related legacy.bracbank.com mirror used for other quarters in this dataset is fully DNS-dead. This document is therefore retrievable only via Wayback Machine capture timestamp 20230807121128. Source PDF is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext extraction yields no usable text), so all figures were read visually from 150dpi page renders (pg-01 through pg-22 of an approx. 34-page filing; only the first 22 pages were rendered).
